title: The perfect four days in Dubai
excerpt: A balanced plan for first-time visitors, with icons, desert and sea, and time to breathe.
author: OneVaya Travel Design

body.text: Four days is the sweet spot for a first visit to Dubai. It is long enough to see the icons and slow enough to enjoy them. The secret is timing: the right attraction at the right hour, with sensible travel time in between.
Day 1: Arrive and settle
Keep the first day light. A private transfer, an afternoon by the pool and an evening stroll by the Dubai Fountain are all you need.
Day 2: Downtown icons
Start at the Museum of the Future when it opens at 10:00, then rest before the Burj Khalifa at 17:30 for sunset.
Day 3: The desert
Desert safaris leave at around 15:00 and return at about 21:00, so plan a slow morning and nothing else that evening.

title: When is the best time to visit Dubai?
excerpt: Season by season, from perfect winter days to great-value summer stays.
author: OneVaya Travel Design

body.text: Dubai is a year-round destination, but each season offers something different.
October to April
Warm days and pleasant evenings, ideal for outdoor sightseeing, desert trips and beach days.
May to September
Hot outside, but excellent hotel value and world-class indoor attractions. Plan outdoor activities for early mornings and evenings.
